gate_verdict: v2_half PASSES the pre-specified gate: guardrails 14/14, DEV in-scope 28/28, DEV out-of-scope 6/6. v2_equal FAILS it at guardrails 12/14 (injector cylinder 3 and cylinder 4). v2_half is therefore the frozen variant and the only one the post-hoc stage may measure.
adoption_recommendation: DO NOT ADOPT, despite the gate pass. The gate as pre-specified contains no DEV-metric floor, and v2_half regresses DEV retrieval against base: symptom hit@1 0.583 -> 0.250 and symptom MRR 0.7111 -> 0.5208, near-duplicate MRR 1.0000 -> 0.9286. It does improve DEV symptom hit@5, 0.917 -> 1.000: the ranker brings the right record into the top five more often but demotes it from rank 1. On n=12 DEV symptom queries that is four queries moving off rank 1, which is small in absolute terms; it is nonetheless a measured regression in the metric the phase set out to improve, so production stays unchanged.
vs_phase_12_1: Authoring beat generation by a wide margin on the thing 12.1 broke: near-duplicate MRR 0.9286 here against 0.4857/0.4929 in 12.1, and guardrails 14/14 against 7/14 and 9/14. The near-duplicate collapse is essentially repaired; the symptom-side gain that would justify adoption is still absent.
statement: Frozen for reproducibility. The artefacts below are exactly what produced the reported numbers. Production retrieval, gate, indexes and records are unchanged by this phase; the expansions are index-only and are never shown to users or cited.
